Anime for beginners: the version of your favorite show you have not watched yet.

Game of Thrones fans start with Attack on Titan, Stranger Things fans get Dan Da Dan, and Squid Game fans go straight to Kaiji: Ultimate Survivor. Bonus for Sherlock fans: Hyouka, a mystery series with zero bodies.

Which show should we convert next?
